purpose: Robustness control that gives all four member-light templates the same 200 kpc baryonic mass aperture, correcting the unequal outer-anchor aperture in the primary spatial-vector diagnostic.
additional_pre_score_disclosure: The primary spatial-vector held-out scores are already known, so this common-aperture correction is a spent-data robustness control and cannot create an independent prediction.
The 200 kpc aperture was chosen because it is an exact Tian baryonic anchor shared by all four systems, not because of a residual score.
The gravity laws, member grid, split, and optimization remain identical to the primary frozen protocol.

baryonic_profile.normalization_mass: Mbar enclosed at the common 200 kpc Tian anchor, calculated as gbar*r^2/G
